name: Phantom Inventory Detection & VMI Replenishment Dispatch
query: Harmonize retailer EDI 852 feeds, detect Kroger store phantom inventory stockout, dispatch store cycle count audit, and trigger Walmart VMI replenishment order.
expected_proof_obligations: Query retailer EDI 852 daily store scan records
Query retailer EDI 830 forward order forecasts and bullwhip volatility
Detect zero-scan phantom inventory anomalies hiding on-shelf stockouts
Query collaborative CPFR consensus exception packets
Dispatch physical cycle count audit task via retailer portal API
Dispatch automated VMI replenishment order via EDI 855
Generate VegaChart CPFR channel sync chart and atomic copy-ready markdown table

eval_models.orchestrator_routing: Agent Orchestrator dynamically decides whether to route the query to Gemini 3.8 Flash (gemini-3.8-flash) or escalate to Gemini 3.1 Pro / 4 Argon (gemini-3.1-pro / gemini-4-argon, subject to availability).
